title: The Impact of Trade on Economic Prosperity

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy
We will use an instrumental variable (IV) approach to estimate the causal effect of trade volume on GDP per capita. Geographic distance is a natural instrument for trade volume because it affects trade costs and thus trade volume, but it is unlikely to directly affect GDP per capita except through its impact on trade. The key assumption for this IV strategy is that geographic distance is exogenous and only affects GDP per capita through its effect on trade volume.

## 2. R Code
```r
# Load required libraries
library(AER)
library(lmtest)
library(sandwich)

# Read the data
data <- read.csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s78_data.csv")

# Run the first stage regression
first_stage <- lm(x ~ z + controls, data = data)

# Run the second stage regression
second_stage <- lm(y ~ x + controls, data = data)

# Calculate the IV estimate
iv_estimate <- coeftest(second_stage, vcovHC(estfun(second_stage, vcov. = vcovHC), type = "HC1"))

# Print the IV estimate
print(iv_estimate$estimate)

# Robustness check: using different types of HC standard errors
iv_estimate_hc0 <- coeftest(second_stage, vcovHC(estfun(second_stage, vcov. = vcovHC), type = "HC0"))
iv_estimate_hc2 <- coeftest(second_stage, vcovHC(estfun(second_stage, vcov. = vcovHC), type = "HC2"))

# Print the robustness check results
print(iv_estimate_hc0$estimate)
print(iv_estimate_hc2$estimate)
```

## 3. Expected Findings
We expect the IV estimate of the effect of trade volume on GDP per capita to be positive. This is because increased trade volume allows countries to specialize in their comparative advantages, leading to higher productivity and economic prosperity. The magnitude of the effect is difficult to predict without more information about the specific countries and time periods in the dataset, but it is likely to be economically significant. The robustness checks using different types of HC standard errors should provide consistent results, indicating that the IV estimate is robust to different assumptions about the error structure.

_ground_truth.identification_strategy: Use geographic distance as an instrument for trade volume to isolate its impact on GDP per capita.
_ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Increased trade volume has a significant negative effect on log GDP per capita.
